correctness.rationale: On a positive 2x2 table, reconstruct P=E[.|X], Q=E[.|Y] 4x4 weighted averaging matrices. Direct PQ-QP multiplication gives four rows of signed terms using u=b/(a+b),v=d/(c+d),r=c/(a+c),s=d/(b+d). Both delta_X=s-r and delta_Y=v-u have sign ad-bc, so each absolute row sum is twice max of two positive terms, yielding exact formula in RESULT.md for L∞. For fixed theta=ad/(bc), logistic odds p=t/(1+t),q=theta*t/(1+theta*t) gives |q-p|=|theta-1|t/((1+t)(1+theta*t)), maximized at t=1/sqrt(theta), equal |sqrt(theta)-1|/(sqrt(theta)+1). All conditional probs strictly between zero and one imply strict <2Y for theta!=1. Family (sqrt(theta)*T,T,1/sqrt(theta),1) has fixed odds and achieves limiting 2Y as T->infty; theta=1 commutator zero. Independently multiplied 625 positive integer tables exactly and checked sharpness family. No extrapolation beyond positive tables or L∞.
